details: CONFIRMED by reading: rules/working-with-me.md lines 55-58 (calque bullet) against lines 65-68 (the added sentence),

what every Russian reply is generated from, so an example in it is imitated; this is the same kind of slip (the
rule inviting the shape) the cause report found for run 3. Also "gate, то есть полная проверка" in the same
sentence is a two-word gloss; it would read better as "полная проверка перед merge", but it is not one word.

evidence: "A local word set beside the term as a gloss ("<local word>, that is, hook") is the same calque: write the English
term and, the first time, explain it in plain words, never with a one-word equivalent in my language."
... "a pronoun that points at the Russian gloss ("hook, то есть проверка, и она прошла") is allowed."
"A one-word local equivalent of the term is a calque: FAIL."
failing_case: rules/working-with-me.md:65-68 now reads: a pronoun that points at the Russian gloss ("hook, то есть проверка, и она
прошла") is allowed. The bullet just above (line 55-57) says a local word set beside the term as a gloss is the same
calque: "explain it in plain words, never with a one-word equivalent in my language". The it-terms-ru grader
no-calques.md FAILs "a one-word local equivalent of the term", e.g. "hook (крючок)". So the rule text now shows, as

copies the example ("hook, то есть проверка, и она прошла") is told it is fine by one sentence and wrong by the other.

перед merge, и она прошла"), so the two bullets agree.
